column1:
1|老师：你们好，欢迎来到中国留学！请把护照、签证和入学通知书给我。
白家月：好的。这是我们的证件和材料。
（几分钟后。）
老师：办好了，这是你们的学生证，下周一开始上课。先试听两周，然后在网上选课。
白家月、陈天中：谢谢老师。
老师：不客气，你们以后有任何问题都可以来找我。|Teacher: Hello, welcome to China to study! Please give me your passports, visas and admission letters.
Bai Jiayue: Certainly. Here are our documents and materials.
(A few minutes later.)
Teacher: All done. Here are your student cards. Classes begin next Monday. Attend trial classes for two weeks, then choose your courses online.
Bai Jiayue and Chen Tianzhong: Thank you, teacher.
Teacher: You're welcome. If you have any questions in future, you can come to me.

2|陈天中：你看，咱们的校园真大！有图书馆、体育馆、超市，还有好几个食堂。
白家月：是啊，我觉得学校就像一座小城市，什么都有，方便极了。
陈天中：刚才老师说，咱们可以申请奖学金，你了解过吗？
白家月：我听说过一点儿，好像成绩好、表现好的学生都有机会获得奖学金。
陈天中：那太好了，要是申请到奖学金，就能减轻不少经济压力。
白家月：没错，我们一起加油吧！|Chen: Look, our campus is huge! There are a library, gym, supermarket and several dining halls.
Bai: Yes, I think the university is like a small city. It has everything and is very convenient.
Chen: The teacher just said we can apply for scholarships. Have you looked into it?
Bai: I've heard a little. It seems students with good results and performance have a chance to receive one.
Chen: Wonderful. If we get scholarships, it will reduce a lot of financial pressure.
Bai: Exactly. Let's work hard together!

3|随着中国的发展，越来越多的外国学生来到中国的大学学习。他们可以先上一年的中文课程，然后根据自己的兴趣和需要选择专业。除了读本科课程，他们还可以申请读硕士研究生或者博士研究生。\n在大学里，外国学生可以和中国学生一起学习、做研究、参加校园活动。通过这些交流，外国学生能更快地适应中国的大学生活。|As China develops, more and more international students come to study at Chinese universities. They can take a year of Chinese courses first, then choose a major based on their interests and needs. Besides undergraduate courses, they can also apply for master's or doctoral programmes.\nAt university, international students can study, research and participate in campus activities with Chinese students. Through these exchanges, they can adapt more quickly to university life in China.

4|很多外国学生来中国学习以前，就已经想好了自己的发展方向。有人对经济感兴趣，希望将来在国际公司工作；有人喜欢学医，打算回国后当一名医生；还有人对教育有热情，想要成为一名教师。\n陈天中想选择跟经济有关的专业，希望通过学习，了解更多国际贸易方面的知识。安妮以后想做一名中文老师，所以要选择国际中文教育专业。对他们来说，来到中国留学，一方面是为了学习语言和知识，另一方面也是为将来的工作和生活做准备。|Before coming to China, many international students have already considered their future direction. Some are interested in economics and hope to work for an international company; some enjoy medicine and plan to become doctors back home; others are enthusiastic about education and want to teach.\nChen Tianzhong wants an economics-related major to learn more about international trade. Annie wants to teach Chinese, so she will choose international Chinese language education. For them, studying in China is both a way to learn language and knowledge and preparation for future work and life.

1|房东：请进！我给你们介绍一下，这个房子有两个房间，那个大房间出租，房租每月5500元。现在已经收拾好了，想租的话，今天就可以搬进来。
白家月：嗯，这个房间真不小，还挺亮。小区离我们学校也不远。
房东：是的，我们小区离地铁站也很近，生活上很方便。如果决定租了，告诉我就是了。
白家月：好的，我们再去看看外边的环境。|Landlord: Come in! Let me show you around. This home has two rooms. The large room is for rent at 5,500 yuan a month. It is tidy now; if you want to rent it, you can move in today.
Bai: Mhm, this room is quite big and bright. The neighbourhood is not far from our school.
Landlord: Yes, it is also near a subway station, so daily life is convenient. If you decide to rent it, just tell me.
Bai: All right. We will have another look at the surroundings.

2|李文：家月，你看，那边还有个小花园。
白家月：嗯，这个小区到处是花，还种了不少树，周围也很安静。
李文：是啊！这个小区的环境真不错，不过我听说，附近有十几家公司，很多刚毕业的学生都租住在这里。周末他们可能会玩到很晚，恐怕会影响你休息。
白家月：没关系，我还想多认识一些朋友，和他们一起玩呢。
李文：是呢，大家可以一起热闹热闹。
白家月：这里房租合适，环境很好，而且房东也热情，所以我决定租这个房子了，明天就入住新家。|Li Wen: Jiayue, look, there is a small garden over there too.
Bai: Yes, there are flowers everywhere and many planted trees. The surroundings are quiet too.
Li: Yes, the environment is good. But I heard there are more than ten companies nearby and many new graduates rent here. They may stay up late on weekends, which might disturb your rest.
Bai: That's fine. I want to meet more friends and spend time with them.
Li: Right, everyone can have fun together.
Bai: The rent is suitable, the environment is good and the landlord is friendly. I've decided to rent it and move into my new home tomorrow.

3|8月25日，晴
昨天我顺利租到了合适的房子，今天李文帮我搬家。搬进去的时候，房东又向我介绍了一下房子里的东西，并告诉我这些东西怎么用。
我看了一下，客厅里有椅子、沙发，还有一台大电视；厨房里有冰箱和一些做饭用的东西，不过，我平常主要在学校食堂吃，基本上不做饭。我租的房间里，除了一张床以外，还有一台空调、一张书桌和一把椅子。
看完整个房子后，我准备再去买几条毛巾，其他东西还不需要。|25 August, sunny.
Yesterday I successfully rented a suitable home, and today Li Wen helped me move. When I moved in, the landlord introduced the things in the home again and explained how to use them.
I looked around: the living room has chairs, a sofa and a large television. The kitchen has a fridge and cooking equipment, but I usually eat in the school dining hall and rarely cook. Besides a bed, my rented room has an air conditioner, a desk and a chair.
After looking around the whole home, I planned to buy a few towels. I did not need anything else yet.

4|在李文的帮助下，白家月租到了合适的房子。对白家月来说，这次租房并不容易。根据李文的建议，她先在租房网站和App上查看有关信息，查找合适的房子，接着又去看了看房子，同时了解房子周围的环境。她看了好几个房子，才找到一个位置、环境和价格都合适的，最后顺利租到了理想的房子。\n租房的时候，李文告诉白家月，在中国，由于很多刚工作的年轻人工资还不太高，所以他们一开始也不买房，都选择租房。工作几年后，不少人就会买房，因为大家一直觉得，有房才有家，有自己的房子会更有安全感。|With Li Wen's help, Bai Jiayue rented a suitable home. It was not easy. Following his advice, she first searched rental websites and apps for information and suitable homes, then visited properties and checked their surroundings. After viewing several, she found one with the right location, environment and price, and finally rented her ideal home.\nLi Wen told her that in China, many young people starting work have relatively low salaries, so they rent rather than buy at first. After several years of work, many buy a home because they feel owning a home brings a sense of belonging and security.

1|陈天中：请问，花园小区怎么走？
同学：你往前走，到十字路口不要过马路，直接右转就到小区门口了。正好我也去那边，一起走吧。
陈天中：好的。我刚来中国，不熟悉路。北京真是太大了。
同学：北京大是大，不过这边的路基本上都是正南正北、正东正西的，很好找。你也可以用手机地图，很容易就能找到目的地。
陈天中：嗯，不过很多中文地名我还不认识。
同学：没关系，你很快就会熟悉的。|Chen: Excuse me, how do I get to Huayuan neighbourhood?
Student: Walk ahead. At the crossroads, don't cross the road; turn right and you will reach the entrance. I happen to be going there too. Let's walk together.
Chen: Great. I have just arrived in China and don't know the roads. Beijing is so big.
Student: It is big, but the roads here mostly run north–south or east–west, making them easy to find. You can also use a phone map to find your destination easily.
Chen: Yes, but I still don't recognise many Chinese place names.
Student: Don't worry. You'll get familiar with them soon.

2|陈天中：前两天和李文喝咖啡时，他帮我下载了微信和支付宝，教我认识里边的汉字，还教我用手机进行支付。
白家月：他也教了我怎么用这两个软件。
陈天中：现在我不仅会扫码结账，还会用手机在网上购物了。昨天我就在网上订了一台电脑，今天下午一点送到。
白家月：学会了这些，我们在中国生活真是方便了不少。
陈天中：对。快递员要到了，我得马上回去！家月，明天见！
白家月：好的，天中，再见。|Chen: When I had coffee with Li Wen a couple of days ago, he helped me download WeChat and Alipay, taught me the characters in them and showed me how to pay by phone.
Bai: He taught me to use those two apps too.
Chen: Now I can scan codes to pay and also shop online on my phone. Yesterday I ordered a computer online; it arrives at one this afternoon.
Bai: Learning these things has made life in China much more convenient.
Chen: Yes. The delivery worker is coming, so I must go back now. See you tomorrow!
Bai: All right, goodbye.

3|白家月和陈天中刚到北京时就发现，中国人在饭馆或超市结账时，几乎都用手机支付，只有他们用现金结账。\n在李文的帮助下，白家月和陈天中也都学会了用手机支付、网购、寄快递等等。在中国网购，不仅选择多、价格不高，而且送货很快，很多留学生甚至改变了自己的购物习惯。不过，由于网购太方便了，动动手指就能买到想要的东西，他们也开始担心自己在网购时会乱花钱。怎么才能管住自己不乱花钱呢？|On arriving in Beijing, Bai Jiayue and Chen Tianzhong noticed that almost everyone in restaurants and supermarkets paid by phone; only they paid in cash.\nWith Li Wen's help, they learned mobile payment, online shopping, sending parcels and more. In China, online shopping offers many choices, low prices and fast delivery; many international students have even changed their shopping habits. But because it is so easy to buy things with a finger movement, they have started worrying about spending carelessly. How can they control their spending?

4|网上购物或者订票时，我们经常需要提供姓名、手机号、身份证号等个人信息。在提供这些信息时，我们也会担心：我的个人信息能否得到保护？于是，有人在网上说出了自己的担心，很快就有人给出了一些建议。比如，别把密码随便告诉别人，不在网上发自己的车票、机票信息……\n现在，很多国家也通过技术、法律等手段来保证个人信息安全。比如中国的网络安全法、个人信息保护法等就很好地保护了人们的个人信息。|When shopping or booking tickets online, we often need to provide personal information such as our name, phone number and ID number. We may wonder whether this information can be protected. Some people shared their concerns online, and others quickly offered advice: don't casually share passwords, and don't post your train or plane ticket details online.\nMany countries also use technology and laws to safeguard personal information. The text cites China's cybersecurity and personal information protection laws as examples.

1|陈天中：啊，我的手机停机了！怎么办啊？
路人：你好，你看上去很着急，需要帮忙吗？
陈天中：我忘了交电话费，手机停机了。我没带现金，手机没有信号，上不了网，买不了地铁票了。
路人：你要去哪儿？我帮你买张票。
陈天中：太感谢你了，我要去北京大学站。对了，能不能告诉我你的联系方式？我想把钱还给你。
路人：别客气，很高兴能帮到你。|Chen: Oh, my phone service has been suspended! What should I do?
Passer-by: Hello, you look worried. Do you need help?
Chen: I forgot to pay my phone bill. I have no cash, no signal and no internet, so I cannot buy a subway ticket.
Passer-by: Where are you going? I'll buy you a ticket.
Chen: Thank you so much. I'm going to Peking University Station. Could you give me your contact details? I want to pay you back.
Passer-by: You're welcome. I'm glad I could help.

2|白家月：阿姨，您怎么站在这儿不上楼？
邻居：我开车去超市买了不少东西，刚拿过来了一些。我先休息一会儿，再去车里拿剩下的。
白家月：我正好要上楼，我帮您提上去吧。
邻居：不用不用，这几个袋子太重了，我自己拿吧。
白家月：没事，我提着这些东西就算锻炼身体了，再说邻居之间就是要互相帮助啊。
邻居：谢谢家月！那就辛苦你了。|Bai: Auntie, why are you standing here instead of going upstairs?
Neighbour: I drove to the supermarket and bought a lot. I've just brought some over. I'll rest a little, then get the rest from the car.
Bai: I'm going upstairs anyway. Let me carry them for you.
Neighbour: No, these bags are too heavy. I'll carry them myself.
Bai: It's fine. Carrying them counts as exercise, and neighbours should help one another.
Neighbour: Thank you, Jiayue. Sorry to trouble you.

3|在城市里，人们出行的方式越来越多。短距离出行时，骑自行车往往是人们常见的选择。白家月就很喜欢骑车去学校，她觉得这样既方便，又能锻炼身体，还能保护环境。\n除了骑自行车，人们还会选择骑电动车。电动车速度快，价格不高，充电也很方便，所以越来越流行。陈天中平时也骑自行车，不过为了省力气，他最近打算买一辆电动车。|People have more and more ways to travel in cities. For short journeys, cycling is a common choice. Bai Jiayue likes cycling to school because it is convenient, provides exercise and protects the environment.\nPeople also choose electric bikes. They are fast, inexpensive and easy to charge, so they are becoming more popular. Chen Tianzhong usually cycles too, but recently he has planned to buy an electric bike to save effort.

4|在中国，乘客可以在不少地铁站里直接扫码购买食物和饮料，有的地铁站还提供免费借雨伞、发雨衣等服务。
有些地铁站附近公司比较多，工作日站里还有早餐车，没来得及吃早饭的人在这里就能买到热包子和牛奶等，省了不少时间。有的地铁站里甚至还有鲜花店，乘客下班时可以顺便买花送给家人。
这些小小的服务，不仅方便了人们的出行，也让大家的心情变得更加愉快。|In many Chinese subway stations, passengers can scan codes to buy food and drinks. Some stations also lend umbrellas free of charge or provide raincoats.
Stations near many offices may have breakfast carts on working days. People who missed breakfast can buy hot buns and milk, saving time. Some stations even have flower shops, where commuters can buy flowers for family on the way home.
These small services make travel more convenient and lift people's mood.

1|刘明：家月，你来中国至少两个月了，习惯吃中餐了吗？
白家月：习惯了，而且我很喜欢吃中国菜。
王一雪：你还没吃过水煮鱼吧？这是我专门为你做的。
白家月：看起来不像水煮鱼，更像“油煮鱼”。
王一雪：这道菜是先用水把鱼煮熟，最后再倒上辣椒油，其实只有最上面那一层是油。你尝尝，对你来说辣不辣？
白家月：辣是辣，但是非常好吃！
王一雪：那你多吃点儿，不要客气。|Liu Ming: Jiayue, you've been in China at least two months. Are you used to Chinese food?
Bai: Yes, and I really like it.
Wang Yixue: You haven't tried Sichuan boiled fish, have you? I made it specially for you.
Bai: It looks more like oil-boiled fish than water-boiled fish.
Wang: First the fish is cooked in water, then chili oil is poured on top. Only the top layer is oil. Try it: is it spicy for you?
Bai: It is spicy, but delicious!
Wang: Then have some more. Make yourself at home.

2|王一雪：我听李文说，你现在也爱吃辣了？
白家月：是的，来中国以后，我越来越喜欢吃辣了。
王一雪：我们以前不太敢吃辣，吃完可能会肚子不舒服，不过现在也慢慢适应了。
刘明：对，我们现在都不怕辣了。家月，你是“不怕辣”还是“怕不辣”？
白家月：中文真有意思，相同的字，顺序一换，意思就变了。
李文：你的中文水平够高的，这都听懂了！你说得对，“不怕辣”是说不怕吃辣的菜，“怕不辣”是担心菜还不够辣呢。
白家月：我还达不到“怕不辣”的水平，甚至也不能算“不怕辣”，只是喜欢吃辣。|Wang: Li Wen told me you like spicy food now too?
Bai: Yes, since coming to China I've liked it more and more.
Wang: We didn't dare eat much spicy food before because it might upset our stomachs, but we've gradually adapted.
Liu: Yes, we're no longer afraid of spice. Jiayue, are you 'not afraid of spicy' or 'afraid it isn't spicy'?
Bai: Chinese is interesting: change the order of the same characters and the meaning changes.
Li: Your Chinese is really good to understand that! The first means not fearing spicy dishes; the second means worrying they aren't spicy enough.
Bai: I haven't reached the second level, or even quite the first. I just like spicy food.

3|周末，白家月、陈天中、李文和安妮聚在一起吃午餐。白家月想吃辣的，要了辣子鸡；陈天中爱吃甜的，想尝尝松鼠鳜鱼；李文更喜欢吃咸的，选了红烧羊肉和一道凉菜；安妮听说贵州酸汤很有名，点了酸汤米线。他们边吃边聊，非常愉快。\n结账时，李文想请客，但大家觉得还是各付各的更合适。于是，李文付完钱后，大家把钱转给了他，还笑着说下次再一起聚餐。|On the weekend, Bai Jiayue, Chen Tianzhong, Li Wen and Annie met for lunch. Bai wanted spicy chicken; Chen liked sweet food and wanted squirrel-shaped mandarin fish; Li preferred savoury food and chose braised lamb and a cold dish; Annie had heard of Guizhou sour soup and ordered rice noodles in sour soup. They chatted happily while eating.\nWhen paying, Li offered to treat everyone, but they felt paying their own shares was better. After Li paid, they transferred their shares to him and happily suggested another meal together.

4|今天吃饭的时候，大家坐得比较随意。李文告诉白家月，在中国，正式聚餐和普通聚餐不同，正式聚餐时人们比较重视座位的安排，比如可以按照年龄大小来安排，年龄比较大的客人往往会坐在中间或者面对门口的座位。大家坐下时，主人会请客人先坐。如果聚餐时有老人，年轻人要等老人坐下后再坐。\n白家月听后觉得很有意思，她认为这么做是照顾客人、尊重老人的表现。|Everyone sat casually at today's meal. Li Wen told Bai Jiayue that formal dining in China differs from ordinary meals: more attention is paid to seating, for example by age. Older guests often sit centrally or facing the entrance. Hosts invite guests to sit first, and younger people wait for older people to sit before sitting themselves.\nBai found this interesting and thought it showed care for guests and respect for older people.

1|白家月：喂，李文，我身体不舒服。
李文：你怎么了？听你的声音，好像感冒了。
白家月：对，我还发烧，一直咳嗽，咳得很厉害。
李文：那挺严重的，最好赶快去医院检查一下。
白家月：我也这么想，不过我来中国后还没去过医院，不知道怎么在中国的医院看病。
李文：没关系，我陪你一起去，还能帮你翻译。你在家等一下，我现在就去接你。
白家月：太好了！有你陪着，我就放心多了。|Bai: Hello, Li Wen, I don't feel well.
Li: What's wrong? You sound like you have a cold.
Bai: Yes, and a fever. I keep coughing badly.
Li: That sounds serious. You'd better go to hospital for a check soon.
Bai: I think so too, but I haven't been to a hospital since coming to China and don't know the process.
Li: Don't worry. I'll go with you and can translate. Wait at home; I'll pick you up now.
Bai: Great! I feel much more reassured with you coming.

2|李文：护士，您好，我的这位外国朋友生病了，第一次来这里看病，需要怎么做？
护士：请在这张表上写上病人的姓名、性别、国籍、年龄、电话号码和家庭地址。
李文：我写好了，您看看，这样可以吗？
护士：没问题，您拿着病人的护照去挂号吧。
李文：家月，我去排队挂号，你先在大厅休息，别着急。
白家月：好的，真是太谢谢你了！
李文：你跟我有什么好客气的。|Li: Hello, nurse. My international friend is ill and this is her first visit. What should we do?
Nurse: Write the patient's name, gender, nationality, age, phone number and home address on this form.
Li: Done. Could you check whether this is all right?
Nurse: Yes. Take the patient's passport to register.
Li: Jiayue, I'll queue to register. Rest in the lobby and don't worry.
Bai: All right, thank you so much!
Li: No need to be so formal with me.
